# Allman, Baños, Mitchell, Rhodes 2023

Source: E. S. Allman, H. Baños, J. D. Mitchell, J. A. Rhodes, *The tree of blobs of a species network:
identifiability under the coalescent*, J. Math. Biol. 86 (2023), 10,
<https://doi.org/10.1007/s00285-022-01838-9>. It is a paper of the hub lean4-phylo-tree-of-blobs, formalized in its own
repository, [lean4-allman2023](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023), which this repository requires;
its [report](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/main/docs/Allman2023/REPORT.md) is the audit
of the source.

NANUQ is written in the language that Allman et al. 2023 later fixed for the tree of blobs: the
formalization reads NANUQ's `N⁻` (Definitions 4 and 5) on the semidirected network `𝒩⁻` of their
Definition 5, built from the LSA network `𝒩⊕`, and reads `Q̃` of NANUQ's Definition 20 as they read
`T_rd(𝒩⁻)`, by suppressing the nodes of degree 2 of a tree and reading the literal topologies of a
labelled tree on four taxa.

Each result that the proofs here use is stated in this directory, in the namespace
`External.Allman2023`, in the source's terms (the definitions of lean4-allman2023 and of the
libraries), and proved from the theorem of lean4-allman2023 named below; the paper's library uses
these statements. None of them has a row in lean4-allman2023's routes file: they are steps that the
source states without a label, or the facts on trees that its proof of Lemma 1 omits.

[`Allman2023.nodeDegree`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/BlobDefinitions.lean#L48), [`Allman2023.suppressDegreeTwo`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/BlobDefinitions.lean#L396), [`Allman2023.ChainLink`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/BlobDefinitions.lean#L389),
[`Allman2023.TreeSuppression.IsSideOf`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/TreeSuppression.lean#L24)) and those of the libraries. [`Allman2023.semidirected`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/Definitions.lean#L432) and
[`Allman2023.lsaNode`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/Definitions.lean#L357) take their arguments through the two facts that a network of Definition 1 is
phylogenetic and binary ([`Allman2023.IsBinaryNetwork.isPhylogenetic`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/Definitions.lean#L116),
[`Allman2023.IsBinaryNetwork.isBinary`](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-allman2023/blob/46efa61d0988df12649089689ae77bc100be034f/Allman2023/Networks/Definitions.lean#L130)), which the statements of [`Nanuq/Networks/Semidirected.lean`](../../Networks/Semidirected.lean)
use with them, as part of the definition of `𝒩⁻`.
